members.about: Solving email chaos as full-time GTM Engineer at Pidgy, then trying to sell it (to you?). Upcoming business philosopher. Computer science background, sales brain. When I'm not doing that: Brazilian jiu-jitsu, planning a surf or hike trip, learning Chinese, or counting the days until I can go back to China. Still builds the odd special website, for people who pay on time. Always down for a good conversation. Say hi.
